## Divider.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `orientation` :: The direction of the rule. A vertical divider sits in a row and stretches to the row's height.
- `line` :: The line style: solid, dashed, a faint hairline or a strong rule.
- `spacing` :: The space on either side of the rule, from the shared size ladder.
- `textSize` :: The scale of the label centred in the rule. @default 'text-xs'
- `textColor` :: The ink of the label; muted by default so the rule still reads as a divider first. @default 'text-muted'
- `children` :: Text centred in a horizontal rule. Not drawn on a vertical divider.
